Jordan: CI is red on master (linux-x64). allocator::concurrent_free_ordering_test failing intermittently :face_with_head_bandage:
Jordan: repro locally sometimes, can't repro with `bazel test //runtime/allocator:concurrent_free_ordering_test --runs_per_test=100`
Jordan: failing log:
```
FATAL: Assertion failed at runtime/allocator/allocator_test.cc:214
Expected free_count == ref_count
free_count=42 ref_count=41
Backtrace:
  0 0x7f... allocator::free
  1 0x7f... allocator::concurrent_free_ordering_test
```
Sam: @jordan can you trigger a rerun in CI? Might be a transient infra flake.
Jordan: triggering now
devops-bot: Rerun queued for job: builders/linux-x64/bazel-test #12457
devops-bot: Rerun finished: FAILED (same test)
Sam: OK that's a flake. Can you bisect? I can run bisection if you give me the commit range.
Carla: Noticed a couple allocator changes in the last 3 merges: tcg/allocator-compact and pr/avoid-deterministic-lock-order. Could be related.
Mariya: @sam @jordan my intuition: non-deterministic iteration order in the free-list when multiple threads free at the same time. We had a recent change that switched from ordered buckets to hashed buckets.
Mariya: Suggests adding deterministic seed to the test harness or add an assertion that prints the per-thread free counts before failing for triage.
Sam: I'll kick off a git bisect run on my laptop. Jordan, can you add an extra CI job that runs the test 500x with `--runs_per_test=500` so we can get a repro probability?
Jordan: yeah opening a quick PR to mark flaky and add debug logs + new profile job. Assigning to myself.
Jordan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/allocator-flake-diagnostics
Sam: For bisect: I'll run `git bisect start origin/main --` then `git bisect run bash -c "bazel test //runtime/allocator:concurrent_free_ordering_test --runs_per_test=1"` — will report back.
ci-bot: Note: flaky test reporter created ticket #INF-623
Carla: If bisect points to the hashed-bucket change, we should consider reverting or adding a memory fence/ordering fix.
Jordan: thanks all — I'll post results here. cc @mariya
Mariya: :eyes: thanks Jordan
Sam: ping me when bisect finishes, I'll help root-cause.
Jordan: will do — moving this to triage backlog
